---
name: handover
description: Produce a structured OMVCS work-package handover that another agent can continue from without relying on conversation memory.
---

# Handover procedure

1. Copy `docs/handovers/HANDOVER-TEMPLATE.md`.
2. Record work item, branch, and HEAD.
3. List exact normative sections implemented.
4. List files changed and tests added.
5. Record commands actually run and outcomes.
6. State semantic decisions beyond the Specs. Normal answer: `None`.
7. List Design Gaps and assumptions.
8. List known limitations and remaining work.
9. Confirm working-tree state.
10. Confirm whether any push occurred and whether remote publishing was enabled.
11. The receiving agent must be able to resume from this file without relying on chat history.
